* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “May add 2 pilots and 4 passengers. Vader deploys -3 aboard. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Vader's Personal Shuttle (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
